description: Aptiv PLC is a public limited company incorporated under the laws of Jersey and resident for tax purposes in Switzerland, whose ordinary shares are publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol APTV, having been created in a December 2024 reorganization in which Old Aptiv established a new publicly listed Jersey parent company that was renamed Aptiv PLC. Aptiv supplies advanced safety, connectivity and security systems and software to the automotive sector through three reportable segments: Intelligent and Advanced Systems, providing critical technologies and services to enhance vehicle safety, security, comfort and convenience, including intelligent sensors, high-performance compute platforms and advanced software tools; Engineered Components, providing connection systems, high-performance interconnects and cable management and protection solutions; and Electrical Distribution Systems, providing low voltage and high voltage power, signal and data distribution solutions.
